document.title: Genetically modified crops
document.question:
Some people believe that genetically modified crops are the best way to feed the world’s growing population. Others argue that these crops are too risky for human health and the environment.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
